people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to Me,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith Jehovah.
